lines.en: label kaorinoongen2:
scene kaorinoongen2
I give Kaori a call and ultimately wind up meeting her near her house to go for a walk through the neighborhood.
lines.zh: 我给 Kaori 打了个电话，最后约在她家附近见面，一起在街区里走走。

lines.en: I find out during this journey that Kaori is quite popular around here.
lines.zh: 这一路上我才发现，Kaori 在这一带相当受欢迎。

lines.en: I mean, it would be hard not to be with how she looks- but it seems like most people genuinely like her.
lines.zh: 我是说，凭她的长相想不受欢迎都难——不过看起来大多数人是真的喜欢她。

lines.en: Several old women out on their porches wave to her as we walk by but then shoot me confused glances as they've likely never seen her with another actual person.
lines.zh: 我们走过时，好几位坐在门廊上的老太太朝她挥手，然后又困惑地瞥我几眼，因为她们大概从没见过她和另一个真正的人在一起。

lines.en: It's cute at first but becomes strangely eery as virtually every porch has an old woman on it.
lines.zh: 起初还挺可爱的，可当几乎每一个门廊上都坐着一位老太太时，就变得诡异起来了。

lines.en: This neighborhood is odd...
scene black
if kaoridate15p3 == False:
We do several laps around what I assume is her block but I don't bother asking which house is hers.
lines.zh: 我们绕着她那个街区走了好几圈，不过我没问哪栋是她家。

lines.en: I figure, sooner or later, I'm bound to wind up there. It's just a little strange asking to come over while we're still this early into our relationship with one another.
lines.zh: 我想，迟早我总会走到那儿的。只是我们才刚到这个阶段就提出要去她家，总有点奇怪。

lines.en: I should wait until I'm 100%% sure that Kaori isn't an alien to go into her residence as well.
lines.zh: 我也该等到我 100%% 确定 Kaori 不是外星人之后，再进她的住处。

lines.en: Ami would be very mad at me if I were to be consumed by an enemy of humanity.
lines.zh: 要是我被人类的敌人吃掉，Ami 一定会非常生气。

lines.en: else:
We do several laps around her block, talking about the different textures of animals and how feathers feel compared to things like fur or scales.
lines.zh: 我们绕着她那个街区又走了好几圈，聊着动物不同的触感，以及羽毛和毛皮、鳞片比起来是什么感觉。

lines.en: I'm sure you can probably guess who chose this conversation topic.
lines.zh: 你大概猜得到这个话题是谁挑的。

lines.en: Either way, it eventually starts to get dark and Kaori announces that she must complete her nightly bathing ritual before heading to bed.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，天渐渐黑了，Kaori 宣布她得完成每晚的沐浴仪式才能上床睡觉。

lines.en: Already knowing full well that she will not allow me to watch said ritual, I shrug my shoulders and agree, heading home after one final lap around the block.
lines.zh: 我早就清楚她不会让我观看这场仪式，于是耸了耸肩答应下来，又绕着街区走了最后一圈，然后回家。

lines.en: $ kaori_love += 1
{i}Kaori's affection has increased to [kaori_love]{/i}!
jump saturdaynight
